description: Complete reproducibility package of the article Scale-admissibility gate for non-intrusive load monitoring in three-phase industrial energy systems with an unmeasured support source (Applied Energy): 29 canonical pipeline stages, shared module and 15 auxiliary Python scripts; six YAML configuration files; trained models (35 .keras) and per-window predictions of six disaggregation models over five seeds; execution manifests; and the public dataset (16 meters, 131,216 records, 177 electrical quantities per meter) in a reversibly transformed form that preserves ordering and temporal structure while protecting the absolute values covered by a confidentiality agreement with the industrial facility. The inverse-transformation key is available from the corresponding author under a Data Use Agreement. Code under the MIT licence; data, models, predictions and manifests under CC BY 4.0. Version 2.0.0 supersedes 1.0.1, which contained an outdated pipeline and an uncorrected dataset.
notes: Files embargoed until 2026-12-20 (90 days after publication on 2026-09-21); the inverse-transformation key of the dataset is not part of the package.
